finalText:
**Found and fixed the leak.**

Connection wasn't getting released when order validation failed. In `processOrder.js`, the code acquired a connection but had no try-finally, so when `run()` threw an error, `pool.release()` never ran. The connection stayed locked until the process crashed.

Added a try-finally block around the handler call to guarantee release, matching the pattern in `handleRequest`. All 4 tests pass now.
